claims.statement: Ingolf Lohmann declares that he transformed Tested Event Model Driven Development from a development method into an executable language with development, debugging, test, linking and effect-verification runtime, and declares this his decisive technical-evolution step.
claims.boundary: Author declaration by Ingolf Lohmann; not an independent legal or worldwide priority adjudication.

claims.statement: The QIK-VRT repository specifies TEMDD as an executable metaprogramming language with explicit lifecycle, conformance and backend semantics.
claims.boundary: Bound to the exact repository source identified by TEMDD-LANG-SPEC; no broader adoption claim is made.

claims.statement: TEMDD separates transport, event, test and effect acknowledgement and requires fresh effect readback for terminal completion.
claims.boundary: Bound to the exact TEMDD specification/declaration sources; no later-stage effect is inferred from an earlier stage.

claims.statement: TEMDD can be mapped architecturally to a pipeline of subject binding, authority resolution, execution, test, observation, readback, acceptance and effect-acknowledgement hardware blocks.
claims.boundary: Architecture interpretation and design proposal; not yet RTL-, FPGA- or ASIC-validated.

claims.statement: Dedicated FPGA or ASIC realization may reduce orchestration overhead and improve latency, throughput or energy efficiency for evidence-bearing state transitions, including artificial-cognition control paths.
claims.boundary: Performance magnitude is unmeasured; synthesis, timing closure and controlled benchmarks are required before any numerical speedup claim.

claims.statement: Patentability, novelty, inventive step and final claim scope of the TEMDD hardware mapping remain to be established against the actual filing and relevant prior art.
claims.boundary: No repository or Zenodo publication is treated as a patentability opinion or granted-right determination.

claims.statement: The exclusive attribution to Ingolf Lohmann is persisted as Ingolf Lohmann's explicit authorship and priority declaration.
claims.boundary: Persistence of the declaration is distinct from independent external adjudication of authorship, patent priority or rights.
